summary: “Vibe coding”一词在本证据中被归于 Andrej Karpathy 于 2025 年 2 月提出，用来描述用自然语言与大语言模型对话、让 AI 生成代码的编程方式。如今它主要指把实现几乎完全交给 AI 编程智能体、靠观察运行结果而非逐行阅读代码来验收的开发实践。这种做法在教育、医疗等非程序员群体中被广泛采用，同时也因安全性和可维护性问题受到批评。

eras.label: 命名与对话式编程
eras.meaning: 该词刚被提出，主要指开发者或非程序员通过自然语言与大语言模型对话、迭代生成代码的新编程范式，并迅速被用于教育和临床等领域的原型开发。

evidence.text: Vibe coding, a term coined by Andrej Karpathy in February 2025, has quickly become a compelling and controversial natural language programming paradigm in AI-assisted software development.
evidence.title: Good Vibrations? A Qualitative Study of Co-Creation, Communication, Flow, and Trust in Vibe Coding

evidence.text: We examine "vibe coding": an emerging programming paradigm where developers primarily write code by interacting with code-generating large language models rather than writing code directly.
evidence.title: Vibe coding: programming through conversation with artificial intelligence

evidence.text: Vibe coding is a recent Generative AI innovation where a human operator provides conversational natural language description of a problem and an AI assistant writes the code to develop a solution.
evidence.title: Generative AI Vibe Coding for Prototyping Industrial Systems

evidence.text: The invention of Generative AI and Large Language Models has recently given rise to "vibe coding" as a new paradigm of software development in which developers use natural language to state their high-level intent rather than writing or even being aware of the computer code.
evidence.title: What is Vibe coding and when should you use it (or not)?

evidence.text: Vibe coding-where high-level natural-language directives orchestrate end-to-end software creation-has emerged as a transformative paradigm in modern development.
evidence.title: A Review on Vibe Coding: Fundamentals, State-of-the-art, Challenges and Future Directions

evidence.text: To address these challenges, we introduce vibe coding, a novel AI-assisted, no-code development approach that enables educators to create interactive, customisable learning simulations without programming expertise.
evidence.title: From technology adopters to creators: Leveraging AI-assisted vibe coding to transform clinical teaching and learning

evidence.text: This innovative practice article reports on the piloting of vibe coding (using natural language to create software applications with AI) for English as a Foreign Language (EFL) education.
evidence.title: A vibe coding learning design to enhance EFL students' talking to, through, and about AI

evidence.text: We explore vibe coding as a rapid prototyping approach powered by generative AI.
evidence.title: Vibe Coding and the New Prototyping Playbook

eras.label: 智能体委托与反思
eras.meaning: 该词更多指把实现整体委托给自主编程智能体、极少审查代码、凭运行结果验收的做法，被当作通向“智能体工程”和规范驱动开发的过渡阶段，并面临安全、质量和开源生态方面的批评。

evidence.text: Vibe coding is the practice where coders rely on AI code generation tools through intuition and trial-and-error without necessarily understanding the underlying code.
evidence.title: Vibe Coding in Practice: Motivations, Challenges, and a Future Outlook – a Grey Literature Review

evidence.text: We find that coding patterns are bimodal: in 41% of sessions, agents author virtually all committed code ("vibe coding"), while in 25%, humans write all code themselves.
evidence.title: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild

evidence.text: “Vibe coding”—where users describe applications in natural language and AI agents autonomously handle all implementation—has rapidly emerged as a mainstream development paradigm.
evidence.title: ViBench: A Benchmark on Vibe Coding

evidence.text: Vibe coding -- accepting LLM-generated source from natural-language intent with minimal review -- is fast and may be adequate for low-criticality consumer software.
evidence.title: Formal-Method-Guided Vibe Coding: Closing the Verification Loop on AI-Generated Safety-Critical Software Through Model-Driven Engineering

evidence.text: We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering.
evidence.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering

evidence.text: Context: Software engineering is moving from AI-assisted practices like vibe coding, in which assistants accelerate individual developers, towards Agentic Software Engineering (ASE), in which autonomous agents are delegated goal-level tasks.
evidence.title: Spec-Driven Development for Agentic Software Engineering: Harnessing Human-Agent Teamwork

evidence.text: Two paradigms have emerged: vibe coding, an intuition-driven approach accepting AI artifacts via observed behavior, and Specification-Driven Development (SDD), which uses structured specifications as the authoritative source of truth.
evidence.title: Specification-Driven Development as the Foundation of AI-Native Enterprise Software Engineering

evidence.text: In vibe coding, an AI agent builds software by selecting and assembling open-source software (OSS), often without users directly reading documentation, reporting bugs, or otherwise engaging with maintainers.
evidence.title: Vibe Coding Kills Open Source

evidence.text: SecureVibeBench: Benchmarking Secure Vibe Coding of AI Agents via Reconstructing Vulnerability-Introducing Scenarios
evidence.title: SecureVibeBench: Benchmarking Secure Vibe Coding of AI Agents via Reconstructing Vulnerability-Introducing Scenarios

evidence.text: In February 2025, as we were delivering an upper-level undergraduate course on Software Engineering in our university, the term vibe coding emerged and quickly became popularized, referring to a practice in which developers describe a project or task in a prompt to an AI model that then generates code artifacts automatically.
evidence.title: From Specifications to Implementation in the Gen-AI Era: Lessons from a Project-Based Software Engineering Course

evidence.text: This review presents a comprehensive analysis of two emerging paradigms in AI-assisted software development: vibe coding and agentic coding.

milestones.why: 该文把 vibe coding 引入临床教学，作为无需编程技能的无代码开发途径，开启了医疗教育领域的应用潮。
milestones.workTitle: From technology adopters to creators: Leveraging AI-assisted vibe coding to transform clinical teaching and learning

evidence.text: To address these challenges, we introduce vibe coding, a novel AI-assisted, no-code development approach that enables educators to create interactive, customisable learning simulations without programming expertise.
evidence.title: From technology adopters to creators: Leveraging AI-assisted vibe coding to transform clinical teaching and learning

evidence.text: Vibe Coding is a clinician-led design framework that embeds expert reasoning and the cognitive ‘feel’ of clinical decision-making into interactive educational tools.

evidence.text: Vibe Coding offers an accessible entry point to create interactive digital applications through human-in-the-loop conversational prompts and AI-assisted workflows.

milestones.title: A Survey of Vibe Coding with Large Language Models
milestones.why: 该综述把 vibe coding 重新界定为依托自主编程智能体、通过观察结果而非逐行理解代码来验收实现的方法。
milestones.workTitle: A Survey of Vibe Coding with Large Language Models

evidence.text: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has catalyzed a paradigm shift from code generation assistance to autonomous coding agents, enabling a novel development methodology termed "Vibe Coding" where developers validate AI-generated implementations through outcome observation rather than line-by-line code comprehension.
evidence.title: A Survey of Vibe Coding with Large Language Models

milestones.title: Is Vibe Coding Safe? Benchmarking Vulnerability of Agent-Generated Code in Real-World Tasks
milestones.why: 该文通过基准测试检验智能体生成代码的漏洞，代表了对 vibe coding 安全性的早期质疑。
milestones.workTitle: Is Vibe Coding Safe? Benchmarking Vulnerability of Agent-Generated Code in Real-World Tasks

evidence.text: Vibe coding is a new software development paradigm in which human engineers prompt a large language model (LLM) agent to complete complex coding tasks with little supervision.
evidence.title: Is Vibe Coding Safe? Benchmarking Vulnerability of Agent-Generated Code in Real-World Tasks

evidence.text: Code generation with large language models (LLMs), often termed vibe coding, is increasingly adopted in production but fails to ensure code quality, particularly in security (e.g., SQL injection vulnerabilities) and maintainability (e.g., missing type annotations).
evidence.title: Training Language Models to Generate Quality Code with Program Analysis Feedback

milestones.title: CAI Fluency: A Framework for Cybersecurity AI Fluency

milestones.workTitle: CAI Fluency: A Framework for Cybersecurity AI Fluency

evidence.text: The main objective of the CAI framework is to accelerate the widespread adoption and effective use of artificial intelligence-based cybersecurity solutions, pathing the way to vibe-hacking, the cybersecurity analogon to vibe-coding.
evidence.title: CAI Fluency: A Framework for Cybersecurity AI Fluency

evidence.text: This mirrors "Vibe Coding," where AI generates syntactically correct but functionally flawed code, except scientific stakes are immeasurably higher.
evidence.title: The Rise of "Vibe Science": How AI Threatens Scientific Rigor
